_comment: A partner feed in a different shape entirely: records under 'data', cursor paging, snake_case keys, a null employer on one entry, and a next_cursor that declares the payload incomplete. PARTIAL coverage means absence from this payload is not evidence of anything, so it must produce no removal signal.
